flagged.reason: The video repeatedly teaches that AO4 (spelling, punctuation, and grammar) is assessed and awarded marks on this paper, including warning students that ignoring AO4 will cost them marks, directly contradicting the specification where AO4 carries no marks on 19th-century prose.
